pages.title: Alex's Caves Fish
pages.text: With $(l)Alex's Caves$() installed, each of its cave biomes has fish of its own that bite on Mariculture rods and nowhere else. They breed in a Fish Feeder like any other fish.$(br2)A Mariculture hook floats on $(l)acid$() and $(l)purple soda$(), and the Toxic Caves and Candy Cavity fish bite only there.

$(l)Toxic Caves$(): Acid Lamprey, in acid.$(br)$(l)Magnetic Caves$(): Lodestone Ray and Ferrofish.$(br)$(l)Primordial Caves$(): Old Lungfish and Amberfin.$(br)$(l)Abyssal Chasm$(): Gulper and Lanternjaw, at night, in salt water.$(br)$(l)Forlorn Hollows$(): Gloomfish and Ghost Minnow, at night.

$(l)Candy Cavity$(), in purple soda: Taffy Tang, Licorice Eel, Peppermint Pike, Chocolate Catfish and Gumdrop Goldfish.$(br2)Each fish names its biomes and fluid in $(thing)catch.biomes$() and $(thing)catch.fluid$() of its species file, so data packs can move them or give other fish a biome. The fluid tags $(thing)mariculture:hook_floats_on$() and $(thing)mariculture:fishing/*$() decide where the hook floats.
